Seacera Polyfilms Sdn Bhd.event: acquired by Scientex Packaging Film Sdn Bhd
Seacera Polyfilms Sdn Bhd.evidence: News and stock exchange reports from 2013 confirm that Seacera Polyfilms Sdn Bhd was acquired 100% by Scientex Packaging Film Sdn Bhd for RM40 million. The company manufactured biaxially oriented polypropylene (BOPP) films for general packaging rather than medical-grade films defined in the market scope.

Leyo Polymer.evidence: The company's official website confirms it is an active manufacturer of thermoplastic elastomer compounds based in Suzhou, China. It offers medical-grade TPU and other TPE resins applicable to the medical and packaging industries.
